purpose: UX-20: equal anonymous Sell/Buy visual emphasis and iconography while language remains a utility control.
ownerSpecification: Прозрачная Цена — инженерное ТЗ быстрого UX-ремонта v2.0, UX-20 / T09 T12 T26.
requiredInvariants: Sell and Buy remain distinct navigation intents only; neither grants or guesses a role.
Both anonymous actions use the same primary button class and both retain ArrowRight.
Existing hrefs, intent values, public market context and registration authority do not change.
Locale active state remains utility styling and does not become the primary CTA treatment.
No protected cabinet, backend, auth, role, tenant, money or release semantics change.
